Google Vertex AI returns 401 Unauthorized when the OAuth2 token is missing, expired, or the service account lacks aiplatform.endpoints.predict permission — verifies the error is mapped to Authentication

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"

import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    try {
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"vertex_ai/gemini-2.0-flash\"}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chat(request)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        System.err.println("${error::class.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }
}
```
